card.name: Commas and links in repeated phrases
card.fires_on: The comma after 'Injection' before 'USP' in solution names, and the word 'in' or a following adjective in a repeated passage about a Scottish castle mansion.

modes.label: Comma before USP
modes.description: A comma right after 'Injection' in a named IV fluid, just before 'USP'.
modes.example: prepared with Sodium Chloride Injection<<,>> USP 0.9% or

modes.label: Castle description
modes.description: The word 'in' or the next word inside a phrase about a rebuilt white granite mansion in Scottish baronial style.
modes.example: had it rebuilt<< in>> white granite as a castellated mansion
